cards.card_text: Then Paul thinks about the believers who have already died, and he calls them those who have fallen asleep in Christ.
cards.verse_text: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

cards.card_text: If Christ wasn't raised, Paul says those who have fallen asleep in Christ are simply resting safely.
cards.verse_text: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

cards.card_text: Then Paul flips it: "But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep." SOMEBODY get this man a microphone!
cards.verse_text: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

cards.card_text: Paul calls the risen Christ the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
cards.verse_text: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

cards.card_text: Because Jesus died and rose again, what does Paul say God will do with those who have fallen asleep in Him?
cards.verse_text: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
